replay_determinants.principle: The decision is a pure function of an exact key plus exact registered authorities. It must reproduce bit-identically from the same inputs, or declare NONDETERMINISTIC_REPLAY.
determinants: the exact service_request_key_ref, resolved by exact key with NO default, latest, nearest or fuzzy match
the exact content hashes of every AuthoritySnapshot consulted (authority_content_hash)
the exact interpretation_semantics_fingerprint of every consulted authority
the exact replay_protocol_ref of every consulted authority
the exact candidate_class_ref and its positively bound membership
the canonical serialisation function (canonical_json / semantic_hash, per current law)
non_determinants: wall-clock time - a decision is valid only under the declared effective_time_or_interval and must not be re-decided by the passage of time alone
iteration or evaluation order over candidates
source array position in the caller's request

ordering_convention.rule: Where the outcome is an admitted set, the emitted serialisation order is fixed by a deterministic canonical sort on (source_universe_ref, release_identity_ref).
ordering_convention.authority_of_that_order: NONE BEYOND REPRODUCIBILITY. It is not a ranking, not a preference, not a priority, not a weight, and not a tie-break. Any consumer reading an order into it has performed an unauthorised inference.

inherited_current_law_that_binds_this: AuthoritySnapshot._validate_family rejects authority_kind in {LATEST, DEFAULT, FUZZY, NEAREST, SEMVER_FALLBACK}: 'mutable/fuzzy authority selection is forbidden' (pre553_empirical_objects.py, verified at b65673abc). This form inherits that prohibition wholesale rather than restating it.

AuthorityRegistry is 'Immutable exact-key authority registry; no latest/default lookup exists.' (pre553_empirical_authority.py:213, verified at b65673abc). This form is the DERIVED lookup the registry deliberately refuses, and it therefore performs its own exact resolution and must never delegate to a default.
REPLAY_STATE already carries REPLAY_VERIFIED, REPLAY_INPUT_MISSING, AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE, REPLAY_UNRESOLVED, HASH_MISMATCH, SEMANTIC_PROJECTION_MISMATCH, NONDETERMINISTIC_REPLAY.

fail_closed_rules.trigger: Any key component absent, unresolvable, ambiguous, or resolving to more than one exact value.
fail_closed_rules.action: Return SERVICE_REQUEST_UNDETERMINED. Emit NO set, not even a partial one.
fail_closed_rules.prohibition: No best-effort, no nearest match, no defaulted component, no partial set.

fail_closed_rules.trigger: No positive exact AuthoritySnapshot governs the service/use.
fail_closed_rules.prohibition: Must NOT be rendered as NOT_APPLICABLE, and must NOT admit anything.

fail_closed_rules.trigger: Two or more positive authorities disagree for the same exact key.
fail_closed_rules.prohibition: Must NOT select the newest, the nearest, the highest version or the most convenient. Version proximity is explicitly not a tie-break.
Must NOT proceed with 'all known sources'. That is the silent backfill of broader sources D15 forbids.

fail_closed_rules.trigger: A candidate has no positive exact admission authority.
fail_closed_rules.action: State UNDETERMINED_NO_POSITIVE_AUTHORITY for that candidate; set candidate_class_coverage = INCOMPLETE.
fail_closed_rules.prohibition: Must NOT be reported as NOT_APPLICABLE and must NOT be silently omitted. Omission fabricates a finding.

fail_closed_rules.trigger: The integrity check on any key component or consulted authority fails.
fail_closed_rules.action: State INTEGRITY_FAILURE, which sits at the top of the decision precedence and cannot be displaced.
fail_closed_rules.prohibition: Must NOT degrade to a lower state.

fail_closed_rules.trigger: A replay of the same exact inputs produces a different result.
fail_closed_rules.prohibition: The result is void; it may not be used downstream.

fail_closed_rules.trigger: A source's declared temporal basis differs from the request's declared temporal basis.
fail_closed_rules.action: State SOURCE_NONCOMPARABLE_AT_THIS_TARGET (or SOURCE_OUT_OF_DECLARED_SCOPE where it is a containment failure).
fail_closed_rules.prohibition: Must NOT normalise the two temporal bases into a common form. Per HQ204's H-A adjudication, no universal point-year-vs-fieldwork-interval binary is adopted.

fail_closed_rules.action: Return NO_ADMITTED_SOURCE_IN_CANDIDATE_CLASS - a first-class SUCCESS with full per-candidate provenance.
fail_closed_rules.prohibition: Must NOT be rendered as an empty list, null, error string, or zero-length success.

fail_closed_rules.trigger: Any attempt to obtain an order, score, preference or weight from the admitted set.
fail_closed_rules.action: Refuse. No such artefact exists and none may be derived from this authority.
fail_closed_rules.prohibition: A consumer that requires an order must obtain it from a separately commissioned source-priority authority.

no_silent_backfill.d15_verbatim: May not silently backfill broader sources.
structural_implementations: candidate_class_ref is a mandatory positively bounded key component - the broader-class backfill is prevented at the key (FC-04).

NO_ADMITTED_SOURCE_IN_CANDIDATE_CLASS, OUT_OF_SCOPE, MISSING_AUTHORITY and UNRESOLVED are added to the forbidden-backfill-target set, joining DECLARED_NONE, SOURCE_NOT_APPLICABLE, TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE, OBSERVED_ZERO, ZERO_SUPPORT, NONCOMPARABLE and NOT_APPLICABLE already present in current law.
APPLICABLE may never be produced by default, inheritance, family membership, version proximity, currency, or absence of a negative.
UNDETERMINED candidates are surfaced, never dropped (FC-05).
candidate_class_coverage is mandatory, so an under-examined class cannot masquerade as a fully decided set.
no_silent_backfill.in_the_absence_of_a_positive_negative_au: The state is MISSING_AUTHORITY or UNRESOLVED - never NOT_APPLICABLE. Silence is not a finding.
no_silent_backfill.d15_also_prohibits: May not average admitted universes. - STRUCTURALLY ENFORCED: the form has no averaging operation and its output is a set of separate entries.

no_implicit_pooling.rule: The function is a decision function, not a combining function.
guarantees: Each admitted entry is independently source-indexed and independently governed.
No operation over the set produces an aggregate, union, intersection, merge, weight, combined denominator, combined numerator or combined estimand.
|admitted set| is not a sample size and is not a denominator.
Composition remains where it already is: pre553_source_relations.py under positively bound relation receipts and the AUTHORIZED_COMPOSITE operation-scoped bundle.
Non-pooled coexistence of multiple admitted sources requires NO pooling authority - and equally, admission does not supply one.

no_locality_implies_priority.prohibition_verbatim: locality or country identity alone does not assign a priority weight
rules: geography_scope_ref and population_scope_ref filter; they never rank.
No local source may be preferred to a non-local source.
No local source may be preferred to another local source on grounds of locality.
Absence of a local source may not promote a non-local one.
There is no tie-break, because there is no order.

same_grain_bounded_succession_feasibilit.test: Is same-grain bounded succession genuinely impossible, forcing an architecture reopen under HQD-125 s15?
same_grain_bounded_succession_feasibilit.evidence: pre553_structural_admission.py already implements the immediate D15 sibling authority (STRUCTURAL_EMPIRICAL_ADMISSION_AUTHORITY) at exactly the grain and with exactly the decision-precedence / public-state-map / decision-matrix idiom this form requires, and does so on top of the same CanonicalSemanticObject + AuthoritySnapshot + exact-key AuthorityRegistry substrate.
same_grain_bounded_succession_feasibilit.consequence: The missing capability is AUTHORITY MATERIAL plus a resolver, not a new architecture. See 07.
